summary: New export glirastes/react/styles.layered.css: the chat styles inside @layer glirastes, so unlayered app CSS wins without specificity fights. styles.css stays unlayered and the default.
howTo: Nothing to do. To use it, import 'glirastes/react/styles.layered.css' instead of 'glirastes/react/styles.css', never both (unlayered beats layered, so with both the layer changes nothing). AiChatPanel, AssistantShell and FloatingChatUI import styles.css themselves; where the bundler loads that import the layered file has no effect. Inside the layer the shipped !important declarations beat an app's own !important. See the building-glirastes-chat-ui skill, Cascade layer.
